label: prototype retrieval evaluation set
warning: NOT a scientifically validated benchmark. Twenty hand-written queries composed for engineering evaluation of the retrieval prototype over the current release (v0.1+Round 2, 145,147 RAG units). Expected values are grounded ONLY in what the current corpus verifiably contains (source titles/authors from manifests/source_manifest.csv); they assert nothing beyond that. relevance=source-level means a retrieved unit counts as relevant iff its source_id is in expected_source_ids. relevance=corpus-gap queries have no relevant material in the corpus by design (documented gap) and are excluded from Recall/MRR. relevance=exploratory queries have no reliable relevance labels and are excluded from metrics; their top hits are reported descriptively only.
metrics_note: Recall@k is source-level: fraction of expected_source_ids whose source appears in the top-k. MRR uses the first result whose source_id is in expected_source_ids.

queries.expected_source_scope: The two released English translations of the Kalpa Sutra (Stevenson 1848).
queries.notes: Both releases are translations OF the Kalpa Sutra; the title string should match lexically.

queries.expected_source_scope: Gaina Sutras (SBE 1884), the released Acaranga + Sutrakrtanga translation.
queries.notes: Jacobi's translation of the Acaranga is the only released Acaranga material.

queries.expected_source_scope: SVK-1001 (also contains Sutrakrtanga).
queries.notes: Spelling variants (Sutrakritanga/Sutrakrtanga) test lexical robustness.

queries.expected_source_scope: Shri Utradhyayan Sutar (Agam Seva) 1920 — Devanagari/Hindi release.
queries.notes: Devanagari query; the only released Uttaradhyayana text.

queries.expected_source_scope: SVK-0016 (transliterated form).
queries.notes: Latin transliteration of the same canonical text.

queries.expected_source_scope: All released Ardha-Magadhi/Paia-sadda dictionary sources (Conference imprints + Sheth).

queries.expected_source_scope: Risabha Deva, the Founder of Jainism (1929).

queries.expected_source_scope: Guerinot's Essai de bibliographie jaina (1906).

queries.expected_source_scope: Any of the released Gujarati-script Jain sources (loose: any hit from this set counts).

queries.expected_source_scope: UNKNOWN — ahimsa could legitimately appear in canon translations, dictionaries or scholarship; no reliable label without reading units.
